_comment: Finyl-DCP — AWS App Runner service definition (ECR-image based, PRIMARY path). Edit every <PLACEHOLDER> then run:  aws apprunner create-service --cli-input-json file://deploy/aws/apprunner-service-input.json --region <REGION>. See deploy/AWS_OPTION1.md for the full runbook. Secrets are referenced by Secrets Manager ARN via RuntimeEnvironmentSecrets and NEVER hardcoded here.

AuthenticationConfiguration._comment_AccessRoleArn: IAM role App Runner assumes to PULL the image from ECR. Create per runbook step (d); trust apprunner.amazonaws.com, attach AWSAppRunnerServicePolicyForECRAccess.

ImageRepository._comment_ImageIdentifier: ECR image URI built & pushed in runbook step (d). Region is af-south-1 (Cape Town) by default — see residency note in the runbook.

RuntimeEnvironmentVariables._comment: NON-SECRET config only. Every sensitive value goes in RuntimeEnvironmentSecrets below.

RuntimeEnvironmentSecrets._comment: Each value is a Secrets Manager secret ARN (created in runbook step (c)). App Runner injects the secret value as the env var at runtime. The App Runner INSTANCE role (InstanceConfiguration.InstanceRoleArn) must have secretsmanager:GetSecretValue on these ARNs.

InstanceConfiguration._comment_Cpu_Memory: 0.25 vCPU / 0.5 GB is the smallest App Runner size — a reasonable pilot. Raise for load. Values are estimates; check current App Runner pricing.
InstanceConfiguration._comment_InstanceRoleArn: IAM role the RUNNING container assumes. Must allow secretsmanager:GetSecretValue on the finyl-dcp/* secret ARNs above (and s3:PutObject on the backups bucket if BACKUP_S3_BUCKET is set). Create per runbook step (c).

NetworkConfiguration._comment: EgressType VPC routes the service's outbound traffic through a VPC connector so it can reach a PRIVATE (publicly_accessible=false) RDS instance in your VPC. Create the connector in runbook step (b) and put its ARN below. If you instead use a publicly-accessible RDS locked down by security group (quick pilot, see runbook tradeoffs), set EgressType to DEFAULT and remove the EgressConfiguration/VpcConnectorArn block.
